classdef.name: XMLExportMap
classdef.shortdesc: A mapping object that maps a style (paragraph, character, table, or cell) to an XML tag.

property.name: mappedStyle
property.shortdesc: The style mapped to the XML tag. Can return: ParagraphStyle, CharacterStyle, TableStyle or CellStyle. Can also accept: String.

property.name: isValid
property.shortdesc: Returns true if the object specifier resolves to valid objects.

property.name: parent
property.shortdesc: The parent of the XMLExportMap (a Application or Document).

property.name: index
property.shortdesc: The index of the XMLExportMap within its containing object.

property.name: markupTag
property.shortdesc: The XML tag applied to the element. Can also accept: String.

property.name: includeMasterPageStories
property.shortdesc: If true, includes stories on master spreads when mapping styles to tags.

property.name: includePasteboardStories
property.shortdesc: If true, includes stories on the pasteboard when mapping styles to tags.

property.name: includeEmptyStories
property.shortdesc: If true, includes empty stories when mapping styles to tags.

property.name: properties
property.shortdesc: A property that allows setting of several properties at the same time.

method.name: toSource
method.shortdesc: Generates a string which, if executed, will return the XMLExportMap.

method.name: getElements
method.shortdesc: Resolves the object specifier, creating an array of object references.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The registered event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.
